changelog: PDF reports for ONT 16S (Emu) runs: 'Report build failed — No readable results' fixed. The report builder only knew the DADA2 layout (taxonomy_table.csv, one row per ASV sequence); it now reads Emu's taxonomy.csv / asv_table.csv (one row per taxon), turns Emu's relative abundances into estimated reads using each sample's classified-read count, shows Emu's read stages (input → QC → primers → non-chimeric), Emu configuration instead of truncLen/maxEE, 'taxa' instead of sequence variants, no ASV-length sections, and species without the '<Genus> sp.' placeholders. Single and comparison reports both work (e.g. emu_db_mar2026 vs emu_silva). DADA2 reports are unchanged (checked byte-for-byte on existing runs). Beta: the report dialog always lists the job it was opened from and refreshes the run list. No restart needed.

previous.changelog: A submitted job is 'queued' until a worker thread really starts it (then 'running', with its start time). It used to be marked running straight away, so a job waiting behind busy slots showed Running · 0 % · no log (HTTP 404). A job cancelled while queued no longer starts later. Beta: a queued job says 'Waiting to start — every worker slot is busy' instead of the missing-log message. Backend part needs a restart (do it when no job is running).
